meta.homeTitle: ArmaPC — Build your ideal gaming PC, on any budget
meta.homeDesc: Learn how to build your own gaming PC, from the most affordable build to the most powerful, with a configurator that checks compatibility in real time.

hero.sub: The interactive guide that walks you through choosing, building and understanding your ideal PC.
hero.rail1Text: And we tell you when we don't know

access.card1Text: Pick every component and create your ideal build.
access.card2Text: Set your budget and get the best options for you.

access.card4Text: Got questions? Write to us, we're here to help.
access.card5Text: See how we protect your information.

tiers.intro: Explore recommended builds based on your budget and needs. From the basics all the way to extreme.
tiers.entradaDesc: Ideal for everyday tasks and basic use.

tiers.mediaAlt: White gaming case with liquid cooling, a top-mounted three-fan RGB radiator and a GeForce RTX ROG graphics card
tiers.altaDesc: Higher performance for gaming and creating.
tiers.altaAlt: White ROG gaming case with orange lighting, liquid cooling and a top-mounted three-fan radiator
tiers.extremaDesc: No limits. The best of the best.

about.text: ArmaPC was born to help everyone understand the world of hardware clearly, practically and without the headaches. We believe anyone can build their ideal PC with the right guidance.
about.step1Text: Pick one of the four tiers or start from scratch, with nothing chosen yet.
about.step2Text: Every component with its price and what it brings, explained right where you choose it.
about.step3Text: Socket, RAM type, graphics card length and power draw, all in real time.
about.step4Title: You take the list with you
about.step4Text: The final build, ready to price at the store without second-guessing a single part.
